command: import {mkdtempSync,mkdirSync,copyFileSync,rmSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';import {join,dirname} from 'node:path';import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {inventory,repository} from './scripts/documentation-lib.mjs';const copy=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'lorcana-opening-clean-type-'));const env=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([key])=>!/(?:password|secret|token|credential|private_key)|^(?:PG|POSTGRES|DATABASE)/i.test(key)));let status=0;try{for(const path of inventory()){const to=join(copy,path);mkdirSync(dirname(to),{recursive:true});copyFileSync(join(repository,path),to);}assert(!existsSync(join(copy,'apps/match-service/dist')));for(const args of [['install','--frozen-lockfile','--offline'],['typecheck']]){const r=spawnSync('pnpm',args,{cwd:copy,env,stdio:'inherit'});if(r.error||r.status!==0){status=r.status??1;break;}}assert(!existsSync(join(copy,'apps/match-service/dist')));console.log('Source-only copy had no app build output before or after ordered package build/typecheck; copied no Git/credentials/dependencies; removed on exit.');}finally{rmSync(copy,{recursive:true,force:true});}process.exitCode=status;
